correctness.rationale: Complete all-parameter Jacobian reduction, exact cyclotomic coefficient lemma, free scaling quotient, projective Hessian determinant and Galois stabilizers prove all geometric, scheme-theoretic and arithmetic assertions. The permutation-orbit formula follows from an explicit root-multiplicity necklace bijection and Burnside. Exact independent brute-force and factorial-sum checks for six parameter pairs verify the displayed table; those finite computations are not the infinite proof. Limitation: characteristic zero only.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The earlier statement is not stronger: its parameter q is restricted to prime order, with p dividing N as a necessary node condition. Here composite order 2p has nodes at all even N and odd N>=p; the field spectrum includes rational closed points, and S_N orbit counts are not determined by the earlier single-orbit prime classification. Lam-Leung structural input is credited, but the resulting exact arithmetic-geometric conclusion is additional.

originality.rationale: Earlier prime-cyclotomic diagonal Fermat section findings assume root order p, whose singularities have no rational nodes. This even-semiprime order 2p family has two cancellation mechanisms and rational-versus-degree-(p-1) arithmetic strata. Lam-Leung give root-of-unity cancellation structure, not its projective hypersurface finite-etale singular scheme or symmetric-group orbit census; Lee treats Fermat ED critical-point root counts with different equations; Cafure et al study symmetric hypersurfaces with different defining families. Targeted mathematical-record, prior-claim and literature comparisons found no equal or stronger geometric classification. An unstated corollary of broad root-count theory is a material remaining risk.
residual_risks: An unstated corollary of two-prime group-ring relations and prior studies of symmetric Fermat sections may already imply some or all the counting and scheme statements.
Unindexed literature or computational tables could give equivalent counts or field structures.
The proof is mathematically self-contained but no independent mathematical audit has been undertaken.

value.rationale: Arithmetic geometry of a natural infinite family of nodal Fermat hyperplane sections changes sharply when cyclotomic order has two prime factors: rational nodes coexist with full-cyclotomic closed points, with exact all-parameter finite-etale scheme, node EGF, smoothness range and coordinate-permutation orbit census. This is not implied just by the possible vanishing-sum lengths and provides precise local and arithmetic information beyond prime-order cases.
